annotations.text: Ad slots are dashed green placeholders. The 300x600 sidebar unit is the earner on a long read; the in-article 336x280 sits after the third paragraph, once someone is committed. Toggle them off with the showAds chip above this artboard.
Every headline here is the kind only your site can write - built from your own sold data. That is the moat against generic card blogs, and the reason these articles can rank at all.
The {{sold-table}} shortcode in the body pulls live comps from your index at render time, so an article stays current after publish instead of going stale the day you write it.
